reviews.text: Extremely unpleasant reception service.
I've had to go there several times for my pets (cats); they are very attentive and calm, which helps to relieve stress. Thank you to the team.

Avoid at all costs! This was the first time in my life I'd ever gone to a vet other than my usual one, and unfortunately, this first experience was very disappointing. I only came to this clinic because it was an emergency and my cat had just been in an accident.

I had an appointment at 2:00 AM and arrived at 1:53 AM. Upon arrival, the reception was very cold. I wasn't asked any questions about my cat's condition or what had happened, despite his meows.

A woman then arrived with her dog. I noticed that the receptionist took the time to attend to her dog and saw him before my cat. After waiting for about 50 minutes, I simply asked calmly why I had been given an appointment at 2:00 AM if I was going to have to wait so long.

I was told that the dog was considered more urgent because he hadn't urinated. I can perfectly understand that a veterinary emergency takes priority; that's absolutely not what I'm complaining about.

What deeply shocked me was the difference in attitude I felt towards me compared to other clients. When I simply asked my question, I was met with a very haughty response that if I wasn't happy, I should just leave.

I can't say for sure why I was treated this way, but I clearly felt a difference in treatment, and this attitude made me particularly uncomfortable.

In an emergency, when you're already very worried about your pet, you expect at the very least to be listened to, respected, and shown a little empathy.

It's really a shame, because I simply came seeking help for my cat.

I do not recommend them.

We wish to thank the entire clinic, and especially Dr. AMGAAD and his team on the evening of September 8, 2026.

We brought our sweet little Scoody, who was in shock. The Emergency Department team did everything they could to save him and were there for him, and for us, until his final moments, doing their utmost to alleviate his pain.

The grief we feel today does not make me forget the compassion of these people who do such good and allow us to begin our grieving process more peacefully. Our thoughts are with them.

My cat suddenly developed a leg problem over the weekend, so I brought him here for a checkup. You can make an appointment by phone beforehand. We arrived in half an hour and waited for about 10 minutes. Because of the X-ray and blood test, my cat was quite scared and stressed, and became aggressive towards the doctor. However, the doctor was very patient throughout the process and treated animals very kindly.

Don't think that the fact they treated your pet (for €1200, no less) will elicit any empathy from them when you return to their emergency clinic if the problem persists. If they think they're too busy, they won't see you. Some emergency! But when it comes to paying, they're all smiles.
Our puppy was perfectly cared for by the team, whom we thank.

We wanted to express our immense gratitude for the care provided to our dog, Blanche, during the night of February 28th/March 1st.

We were deeply touched by your professionalism, responsiveness, and compassion during a particularly difficult time for us. The entire team was exceptional: you answered each of our questions and addressed our concerns with patience and clarity, taking the time to explain everything to us.

Blanche was seen immediately and hospitalized without delay. We felt she was in very good hands that night, surrounded by attentive and caring care.

A huge thank you to Dr. Salomé Lacroix and veterinary assistant Lucie for their warm welcome and professionalism. Thank you also to Dr. Ilias Amgaad and his team, Carmen, Amandine, and Camille, for the excellent communication between the teams, which was extremely efficient. This continuity of care was incredibly reassuring.

We're heading back to Vendée with heavy hearts, but reassured knowing she'll be seen by our vet tomorrow. In these trying times, your listening ear, your presence, and your support make all the difference.

Thank you for your dedication to our animals. Thank you for practicing this profession with such devotion, despite the demanding hours and the intensity of the emergencies.

A huge thank you to you all.

(A little photo of our warrior in good health)

Thank you, thank you, thank you!!!!!!!!!

Quick service.
A very warm welcome and the care exceeded our expectations. My dog, White, is doing much better; without your emergency team, he wouldn't have had much of a chance of survival.
The prices are reasonable and not excessive considering the care provided in the middle of the night.
I wholeheartedly recommend this emergency veterinary clinic.
A very pleasant professional; thank you again.
A big thank you to Dr. Lacroix and the secretary who were very reassuring and transparent with me, as well as gentle with my kitten in the middle of the night.

I was able to get an appointment for my dog ​​at 5 a.m. on a Sunday. The whole team was wonderful. They were incredibly kind to my dog, really took the time to listen to me, and provided him with the best possible care. Thank you so much for helping and supporting us through such a difficult time.

Ulysse and I would like to thank the emergency room team on the August 15th shift (2:00 or 2:30 PM) who were exceptionally professional. They provided a very warm welcome, excellent interpersonal skills, and demonstrated great empathy and competence. Not a day goes by as I pass by the emergency room every day without feeling immense gratitude towards this wonderful team who were the first to do everything possible to save him and who were so concerned about him afterward.
We can't thank you enough!
Inexperienced vets, never set foot in there, I lost my cat!!!

I came in as an emergency for a problem with my 3-week-old kitten. Dr. Meguira and her colleague were efficient, friendly, and very reassuring. We also left with lots of helpful advice that we will follow meticulously. Thank you both!

The service was very quick, and the explanation was clear and detailed.

I can only thank the team for their professionalism in taking care of my dog.

Our 20-month-old dog, Aki, was seen immediately at midnight on Friday night/Saturday morning by a kind, professional, and friendly veterinarian. The receptionist was also excellent, not to mention Hugo, our first point of contact on the phone, who directed us to this after-hours clinic. We highly recommend them!

Prompt service
Fair price for a nighttime emergency
Effective relief for my dog

I came in the middle of the night from Saturday to Sunday with friends to take my cat to the emergency vet. We were seen by Dr. Romain Roguier, who demonstrated great kindness and exemplary professionalism.

Thanks to his attentive care and the palliative treatment he administered, my cat has gained over a kilo, is moving normally, and has regained all his vitality. I am incredibly grateful for his invaluable help.

Dr. Roguier is an incredibly patient veterinarian, both gentle with animals and caring with owners. I warmly recommend this practitioner who practices his profession with passion and dedication.

A big thank you to him from Shrek and his owner.

I greatly appreciated the availability, service, and support during a time when I was worried about my pet's well-being. Very professional! I hope you don't have any problems, but if you do, this center will be able to help you.
Thank you for saving my dog ​​Rhea's life. I will be eternally grateful.

Consulting an emergency vet outside of regular office hours is expensive. Prices are quoted, including information on any additional procedures that might be performed at the vet's office.

Warm welcome, pleasant atmosphere, calm and professional treatment of the animal.
The entire team was very welcoming, and especially Dr. ECREMENT, who took excellent care of my cat. I highly recommend them.
The clinic is very well-equipped, and the staff are welcoming and professional, inspiring confidence. You can tell your pet is well cared for. I wouldn't hesitate to return if needed.

Exceptional care following a collision between a scooter and my dog.
Fast, efficient, professional, and caring.
Thank you.

My cat Pompon, who hadn't eaten for two days, was seen by a very pleasant and professional veterinarian on Sunday.
She examined Pompon, determined which tests needed to be done, and gave me the prices so I could give my consent.
Based on the results, she administered injections and prescribed a four-day course of medication, which I received on-site.
She also gave me instructions for the next steps.
Today he's doing better and is slowly regaining his strength.
Many thanks to the very welcoming and professional team and the veterinarian who took such good care of Pompon.

Excellent service.
The appointment was prompt, and the on-call veterinarian was very attentive and competent.
I am very satisfied with this clinic, which I have used twice already.
During a very painful time, I was received with great kindness and compassion. My poor cat received the best possible care until the very end.

Extremely satisfied with the attention given to our animals and the attentive listening of the veterinary staff.

The teams are calm, composed, and available, which is absolutely essential because, when you come to an emergency hospital, your pet's health is often at risk. This helps reduce our stress and ensures we are well supported.
Delighted to have a clinic dedicated solely to veterinary emergencies. There was a real need in the region.
This past Sunday evening, we unfortunately had to deal with difficult situations involving other animals. We witnessed, by necessity, the distress of several owners, but above all, the responsiveness of the teams and their compassion in the face of grief and/or difficult decisions.

Finally, a relaxation area with a café is reserved for clients, which is relatively rare and worth mentioning.
Thank you again to the teams for the quality of care provided.
It wasn't me who brought Piccolo, it was my partner... she instructed me to thank you for the welcome... 5 stars... and I also thank you for welcoming my four-legged baby so well...

Very professional.
Excellent welcome.

Excellent service.
The vets were very kind to our cat, Mistigris.
Effective diagnosis and treatment.

I was passing by on a Saturday evening at 8 pm and I think I was very lucky. When I arrived, there was no one there. I waited less than five minutes for the vet, and the consultation was done in 15 minutes.

And five minutes later, I was leaving. Excellent service and a very warm welcome. It was a real relief when you're stressed about your pet and something's wrong.
Thank you to the whole team.

My epileptic dog had a very severe seizure. I contacted them, they told me to come in, and they took my pet in immediately. I left him with them overnight so they could monitor him. They called me at the time they said they would, and my pet was doing very well; they had taken excellent care of him. A huge thank you to the veterinarian who treated him and to the entire team. They are very professional and even ask for updates on your pet a few days later to see if he's still doing well! Thank you so much for your professionalism.

We brought in a stray cat with an injured eye. The diagnosis was incorrect. According to our vet, the eye couldn't be saved, even though we were offered surgery because the emergency vet in Taverny said it could be treated. They ask for your credit card before the consultation and offer no help whatsoever to treat this abandoned little animal. Disappointed.
Thank you for your welcome, thank you for listening to my decision and my great sorrow. Thank you.

Highly professional and prompt service.
Excellent support and follow-up phone calls.
Thank you for the quality of your work.
The veterinarian who treated our pet was very compassionate in the face of our distress; he showed great empathy and found the right words to comfort us, and our dog passed away peacefully.
Unfortunately, my cat left before we arrived at the office. The staff was compassionate. We were kindly advised on what to do next. They really took the time. Thank you for everything.

Thank you to these veterinarians for being open when others are closed.
It's very reassuring; the quality of service is excellent, and the staff truly cares for our pets.

The welcome for both the animal and the owners was exceptional. Pitchounette was saved just in time thanks to the appropriate and effective treatments and care. The animal was put at ease. Contact with the owner was maintained. Don't hesitate, go with complete confidence.
Our cat received prompt and effective care in his distress, and excellent follow-up. Thank you!

A warm welcome and excellent care. The veterinarian took the time to explain his diagnosis and observations, making sure we understood perfectly.

We had used the emergency veterinary services before and therefore felt confident in their approach.
I highly recommend them.
An extremely attentive team, advising us with great empathy and very professional.

A humane welcome, even though the outcome of our little poodle's life was fatal on that night of Sunday, February 9th to Monday, February 10th, 2025! We received the explanations we wanted and understood what needed to be done.
So happy to have a vet available for my dog ​​from 8 pm onwards, and in Taverny. Easily accessible. I recommend them.

Excellent experience at this clinic! I could have done without it, but there was an emergency with my pet. We were well received and my pet received excellent care. Thank you to the doctor and the assistant! I highly recommend them! The well-being of animals seems to be their priority, unlike some other clinics!
A dynamic, efficient, and friendly team. My dog ​​was seen quickly. His life was in danger, and he was saved. I thank the team for their work. I recommend them 100%.

Whether on the phone or upon arrival, the doctor and the assistant were wonderful. They were very reassuring and even took the time to answer the phone for my mother, who wasn't there. Thank you for the advice regarding our little kitten.
She was very kind and understanding, giving clear explanations.
Efficient and friendly team, excellent diagnosis and care for my dog.

I don't understand the comments saying they're only in it for the money. When you have a pet, you don't care about its health! ESPECIALLY since you have to understand that there are practically no vet emergencies at night anymore, but THEY are there! Of course, their pay isn't the same as a daytime vet (work nights and you'll understand!!). The vet who took care of my bully was simply INCREDIBLE! Patient, gentle, proactive, but above all, honest! She never pressured us to spend money unnecessarily. And the receptionist is both pleasant and funny!
Thank you to this amazing team!!! ❤️❤️❤️

We came in for an emergency with our cat on the evening of February 6th. We were greeted by a lovely, attentive team and taken care of immediately upon arrival. The vet who saw us did a fantastic job and took the time to do everything necessary. This morning our cat is doing well. A huge thank you to the entire team at the emergency clinic!
Excellent clinic, readily available, with vets who give advice and take the time to treat your pet.
An efficient and very empathetic team. Quality care. Thank goodness they're here.

Excellent welcome and outstanding care thanks to the veterinarian's skill and kindness. State-of-the-art equipment, all tests are done on-site. The location is ideal, right off the A115 Taverny-les-Lignères exit. It's very reassuring to have this emergency veterinary clinic in our area. Thank you so much to the whole team 🙏🙏. …

Our cat was seen as an emergency patient on a Sunday. The team, both reception and the vet, were very attentive. The treatment was efficient. Of course, it's still expensive, but the price is justified to relieve a suffering animal over the weekend.

We came in on Sunday for our dog who was very ill following an infection after a dental cleaning. Kinaï was quickly taken care of and made a full recovery. Thank you to the whole team for the warm welcome, helpful advice, and professionalism.
Extremely fast service for our cat. Clear explanations. Very pleasant staff.

My call was answered very quickly. The veterinarian was very reassuring and kind. There's excellent follow-up afterward, which is much appreciated. Regarding the fees, I find them very reasonable considering the speed of service, the quality of care, and the facility. I highly recommend this clinic for any emergency!

The prices were high, but the quality of care was impeccable. They listened attentively, provided clear explanations, and were very patient. We were able to accompany Kirby, our dog, every step of the way.
Excellent welcome. Good diagnosis and effective treatment.

I wouldn't have received so much comfort, explanation, and professional support from you.

Thank you for everything, and for welcoming and supporting us with our little Samba, who suffered from a serious and untreatable infectious disease.

Thank you, I can grieve and count on you for any emergency or critical end-of-life care, or any other concerns for our beloved cats or dogs.

Don't hesitate, they are there, they are professionals, and they save lives.

Thank you ⚘️ Caroline, Kenzo, and Samba.

Thank you to the veterinary team for their warm welcome and efficiency during my visit. Everything was clear, and most importantly, there were no unpleasant surprises on the bill.

As for my dog… she's doing well, and that's the main thing.
Thank you!

We needed emergency veterinary care Tuesday evening for our cat, Junior. He was seen immediately and received initial treatment. The consultation and explanations provided by the veterinarian were very clear. Even though the outcome was very painful, we were welcomed by people with genuine values.
We highly recommend the Emergency Veterinary Clinic in Brie Comte Robert.

Thank you.
The prices are certainly high, but the professionalism is undeniable, and when a mother leaves with her babies after a C-section on January 1st, it's pure joy! Thank you to the entire team.

I received a call from the clinic in the evening. They answered the call and scheduled an immediate appointment for a cat with a high fever. The veterinary team was attentive and very professional. I highly recommend them.

Maisons-Alfort site.
My dog ​​Ellipse, who was in a semi-comatose state, received prompt care.
The veterinarian did what was necessary and saved her.
I am very grateful.

The Maisons-Alfort emergency veterinary clinic is fantastic! I went there two days in a row for my Australian Shepherd. They did everything they could to see us as quickly as possible. The reception staff and doctors were incredibly attentive to our furry friends, very reassuring to their owners, and the quality of the treatment was truly excellent and very effective. The very next day, we could see an improvement in our dog, who had resumed his usual daily routine. My partner and I are very satisfied with this emergency service.
Thank you so much for the care you provided in Arès.
Very convenient emergency vet clinic as it's open even at night. Car access isn't intuitive, but you can find the place without too much trouble. Warm welcome and attentive vets.

Different teams contacted twice.
Perfect welcome, explanations and treatment tailored to the animal's needs. No negative points whatsoever.
Thank you so much!
Excellent service, quick and professional intervention
Professionalism, humanity, empathy, gentleness, takes the time to explain things and make the best decision for the well-being of the animal, even the most difficult one!

Thank you to Dr. Villulles and his assistant. Automne was seen quickly and received excellent care; they are also very gentle and attentive to the animals' well-being.

A big thank you!
